visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand holds a small green 'Kuperus' bottle in front of a specialized white Yakult delivery cart at night. A woman in a tan cap and brown jacket stands behind the cart, which is filled with colorful health drinks and refrigerated compartments. (2) The camera cuts to a man in a white jacket standing on a busy city street with tall buildings and neon signs. He smiles and gestures enthusiastically while talking to the camera. (3) A close-up shows a finger pointing to various bottles on the cart shelf, specifically a brown bottle labeled in Korean priced at 2,700 won. (4) The man shows the bottom of the bottle cap, revealing two brown medicinal pills nested in a plastic compartment. He looks surprised and amused. (5) He opens the green bottle; the pills remain in the cap assembly as he prepares to drink. (6) He tilts the bottle back, drinking the liquid and swallowing the pills simultaneously. A graphic of a red 'Lao Xie Zhen' box appears on screen. (7) Another man in a black turtleneck takes a sip from a similar bottle. (8) The man in black makes a sharp, grimacing facial expression as if the taste is unpleasant. (9) The screen fades to black and white with the text 'Directed by ROBERT B. WEIDE' overlaying his frozen, disgusted face.
